subject: Lane A takes idle GPU for one bounded step40 stage; Liger remains next
body: GPU remained FREE after the explicit Lane-B Liger handoff. To keep the project moving, Lane A now acquires one bounded conservative quality-trajectory turn: step32 -> step40, rows256-319, +8 nonpaged adamw_bnb_8bit steps, same r4/LR2e-5 recipe. This is quality-trajectory evidence only, not a backend speed test. After training, Lane A will run only the fixed 16-anchor canary, persist/release, and Lane B Liger micro-parity remains the next GPU action. Lane B must fresh-read lease before any GPU start.
